29.18: “O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of Aḇraham, Yitsḥaq, and Yisra’ĕl, our fathers, guard this forever in the intent of the thoughts of the heart of Your people, and prepare their heart toward You.
29.19: “And give my son Shelomoh a perfect heart to guard Your Commands and Your Witnesses and Your Laws, to do all, and to build the Palace for which I have prepared.”
29.20: And Dawiḏ said to all the assembly, “Now baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim.” And all the assembly baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of their fathers, and bowed their heads and did obeisance to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 and the meleḵ.
29.21: And they made offerings to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 and offered burnt offerings to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 on the next day: a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and slaughterings in large numbers for all Yisra’ĕl.
29.22: And they ate and drank before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 with great joy on that day. And they appointed Shelomoh son of Dawiḏ to reign the second time, and anointed him before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 to be leader, and Tsaḏoq to be kohĕn.
29.23: And Shelomoh sat on the throne of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 as meleḵ instead of Dawiḏ his father, and prospered; and all Yisra’ĕl obeyed him.
29.24: And all the rulers and the mighty men, and also all the sons of Meleḵ Dawiḏ, submitted themselves to Shelomoh the meleḵ.
29.25: And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 exalted Shelomoh exceedingly in the eyes of all Yisra’ĕl, and put upon him such royal splendor as had not been on any meleḵ before him in Yisra’ĕl.
29.26: Thus Dawiḏ son of Yishai reigned over all Yisra’ĕl.
29.27: And the days that he reigned over Yisra’ĕl was forty years. He reigned seven years in Ḥeḇron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Yerushalayim.
29.28: And he died in a good old age, satisfied with days, riches and esteem. And Shelomoh his son reigned in his place.
29.29: And the acts of Meleḵ Dawiḏ, first and last, see, they are written in the book of Shemu’ĕl the seer, in the book of Nathan the naḇi, and in the book of Gaḏ the seer,
29.30: with all his malḵuth and his might, and the times that passed over him, and over Yisra’ĕl, and over all the reigns of the lands.

3.1: And these were the sons of Dawiḏ who were born to him in Ḥeḇron: The first-born was Amnon, by Aḥino’am the Yizre’ĕlitess; the second, Dani’ĕl, by Aḇiḡayil the Karmelitess;
3.2: the third, Aḇshalom son of Ma’aḵah, the daughter of Talmai, meleḵ of Geshur; the fourth, Aḏoniyah son of Ḥaggith;
3.3: the fifth, Shephatyah, by Aḇital; the sixth, Yithre’am, by his wife Eḡlah.
3.4: Six were born to him in Ḥeḇron. And he reigned there seven years and six months, and in Yerushalayim he reigned thirty-three years.
3.5: And these were born to him in Yerushalayim: Shim’a, and Shoḇaḇ, and Nathan, and Shelomoh - four by Bathshua the daughter of Ammi’ĕl.
3.6: Yiḇḥar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
3.7: and Noḡah, and Nepheḡ, and Yaphiya,
3.8: and Elishama, and Elyaḏa, and Eliphelet, nine,
3.9: all the sons of Dawiḏ, besides the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
3.10: And Shelomoh’s son was Reḥaḇ’am, Aḇiyah his son, Asa his son, Yahoshaphat his son,
3.11: Yoram his son, Aḥazyahu his son, Yo’ash his son,
3.12: Amatsyahu his son, Azaryahu his son, Yotham his son,
3.13: Aḥaz his son, Ḥizqiyahu his son, Menashsheh his son,
3.14: Amon his son, Yoshiyahu his son.
3.15: And the sons of Yoshiyahu: Yoḥanan the first-born, the second Yahoyaqim, the third Tsiḏqiyahu, the fourth Shallum.
3.16: And the sons of Yahoyaqim: Yeḵonyah his son and Tsiḏqiyahu his son.
3.17: And the sons of Yeḵonyah the captive: She’alti’ĕl his son,
3.18: and Malkiram, and Peḏayah, and Shenatstsar, Yeqamyah, Hoshama, and Neḏaḇyah.
3.19: And the sons of Peḏayah: Zerubbaḇel and Shim’i. The sons of Zerubbaḇel: Meshullam, and Ḥananyah, and Shelomith their sister,
3.20: and Ḥashuḇah, and Ohel, and Bereḵyah, and Ḥasaḏyah, Yushaḇ-Ḥeseḏ, five.
3.21: And the sons of Ḥananyah: Pelatyah and Yeshayah, the sons of Rephayah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Oḇaḏyah, the sons of Sheḵanyah.
3.22: And the son of Sheḵanyah: Shemayah. The sons of Shemayah: Ḥattush, and Yiḡ’al, and Bariyaḥ, and Ne’aryah, and Shaphat, six.
3.23: And the sons of Ne’aryah: Elyo’ĕynai, and Ḥizqiyah, and Azriqam, three.
3.24: And the sons of Elyo’ĕynai: Hoḏawyah, and Elyashiḇ, and Pelayah, and Aqquḇ, and Yoḥanan, and Delayah, and Anani, seven.

4.1: The sons of Yahuḏah: Perets, Ḥetsron, and Karmi, and Ḥur, and Shoḇal.
4.2: And Re’ayah son of Shoḇal brought forth Yaḥath, and Yaḥath brought forth Aḥumai and Lahaḏ. These were the clans of the Tsor’athites.
4.3: And these were of the father of Ĕytam: Yizre’ĕl, and Yishma, and Yiḏbash. And the name of their sister was Hatselelponi;
4.4: and Penu’ĕl was the father of Geḏor, and Ĕzer was the father of Ḥushah. These were the sons of Ḥur, the first-born of Ephrathah the father of Bĕyth Leḥem.
4.5: And Ashḥur the father of Teqowa had two wives, Ḥelah and Na’arah.
4.6: And Na’arah bore him Aḥuzzam, and Ḥĕpher, and Tĕmeni, and Ha’aḥashtari. These were the sons of Na’arah.
4.7: And the sons of Ḥelah: Tsereth, and Tsoḥar, and Ethnan;
4.8: and Qots brought forth Anuḇ, and Tsoḇĕḇah, and the clans of Aḥarḥĕl son of Harum.
4.9: And Yaḇĕts was more esteemed than his brothers, and his mother called his name Yaḇĕts, saying, “Because I bore him in pain.”
4.10: And Yaḇĕts called on the Elohim of Yisra’ĕl saying, “Oh, that You would baraḵ me indeed, and enlarge my border, and that Your hand would be with me, and that You would keep me from evil, not to be my pain!” And Elohim gave him what he asked.
4.11: And Keluḇ the brother of Shuḥah brought forth Meḥir, who was the father of Eshton.
4.12: And Eshton brought forth Bĕyth-Rapha, and Pasĕaḥ, and Teḥinnah the father of Ir Naḥash. These were the men of Rĕḵah.
4.13: And the sons of Qenaz: Othni’ĕl and Serayah. And sons of Othni’ĕl: Ḥathath,
4.14: and Me’onothai, who brought forth Ophrah. And Serayah brought forth Yo’aḇ the father of Gĕy-Ḥarashim, for they were craftsmen.
4.15: And the sons of Kalĕḇ the son of Yephunneh: Iru, Ĕlah, and Na’am. And the son of Ĕlah was Qenaz.
4.16: And the sons of Yehallel’ĕl: Ziph, and Ziphah, Tireya, and Asar’ĕl
4.17: And the sons of Ezrah: Yether, and Mereḏ, and Ĕpher, and Yalon. And she bore Miryam, and Shammai, and Yishbaḥ the father of Eshtemoa.
4.18: And his wife Yahuḏiyah bore Yereḏ the father of Geḏor, and Ḥeḇer the father of Soḵo, and Yequthi’ĕl the father of Zanowaḥ. And these were the sons of Bithyah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mereḏ took.
4.19: And the sons of Hoḏiyah’s wife, the sister of Naḥam, were the fathers of Qe’ilah the Garmite and of Eshtemoa the Ma’aḵathite.
4.20: And the sons of Shimon: Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-Ḥanan, and Tulon. And the sons of Yishi: Zoḥĕth and Ben-Zoḥĕth.
4.21: The sons of Shĕlah the son of Yahuḏah: Ĕr the father of Lĕḵah, and La’dah the father of Marĕshah, and the clans of the house of the linen workers of the house of Ashbĕa;
4.22: and Yoqim, and the men of Kozĕḇa, and Yo’ash, and Saraph who ruled in Mo’aḇ, and Yashuḇi-Leḥem. But the records were ancient.
4.23: These were the potters and those who dwell at Neta’im and Geḏĕrah; there they dwelt with the meleḵ for his work.
4.24: The sons of Shim’on: Nemu’ĕl, and Yamin, Yariḇ, Zeraḥ, Sha’ul,
4.25: Shallum his son, Miḇsam his son, Mishma his son.
4.26: And the sons of Mishma: Ḥammu’ĕl his son, Zakkur his son, Shim’i his son.
4.27: And Shim’i had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children, nor did any of their clans increase as much as the children of Yahuḏah.
4.28: And they dwelt at Be’ĕrsheḇa, and Molaḏah, and Ḥatsar Shu’al,
4.29: and at Bilhah, and at Etsem, and at Tolaḏ,
4.30: and at Bethu’ĕl, and at Ḥormah, and at Tsiqlaḡ,
4.31: and at Bĕyth Markaḇoth, and at Ḥatsar Susim, and at Bĕyth Bir’i, and at Sha’arayim. These were their cities until the reign of Dawiḏ.
4.32: And their villages were Ĕytam, and Ayin, and Rimmon, and Toḵen, and Ashan, five cities,
4.33: and all the villages that were around these cities as far as Ba’al. These were their dwelling places, and they kept their genealogy.
4.34: And Meshoḇaḇ, and Yamlĕḵ, and Yoshah son of Amatsyah;
4.35: and Yo’ĕl, and Yahu son of Yoshiḇyah, son of Serayah, son of Asi’ĕl;
4.36: and Elyo’ĕynai, and Ya’aqoḇah, and Yeshoḥayah, and Asayah, and Aḏi’ĕl, and Yesimi’ĕl, and Benayah;
4.37: and Ziza son of Shiphi, son of Allon, son of Yeḏayah, son of Shimri, son of Shemayah.
4.38: These mentioned by name were leaders in their clans, and their father’s house increased greatly.
4.39: And they went to the entrance of Geḏor, as far as the east side of the valley, to look for pasture for their flocks,
4.40: and they found rich, good pasture, and the land was broad, undisturbed and safe, for some Ḥamites had dwelt there formerly.
4.41: And these written by name came in the days of Ḥizqiyahu meleḵ of Yahuḏah, and smote their tents, and the homes that were found there, and put them under the ban, as it is to this day, and dwelt in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks there.
4.42: And some of them, five hundred men of the sons of Shim’on, went to Mount Sĕ’ir, having as their chiefs Pelatyah, and Ne’aryah, and Rephayah, and Uzzi’ĕl, the sons of Yishi.
4.43: And they smote the rest of the Amalĕqites who had escaped, and dwelt there to this day.

5.1: As for the sons of Re’uḇĕn the first-born of Yisra’ĕl - he was the first-born, but because he profaned his father’s bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Yosĕph, son of Yisra’ĕl, so that the genealogy is not listed according to the birthright,
5.2: for Yahuḏah prevailed over his brothers, and from him came a ruler, although the birthright was Yosĕph’s -
5.3: the sons of Re’uḇĕn the first-born of Yisra’ĕl: Ḥanoḵ and Pallu, Ḥetsron and Karmi.
5.4: The sons of Yo’ĕl: Shemayah his son, Goḡ his son, Shim’i his son,
5.5: Miḵah his son, Re’ayah his son, Ba’al his son,
5.6: and Be’ĕrah his son, whom Tiḡlath-Pileser meleḵ of Ashshur took into exile. He was leader of the Re’uḇĕnites.
5.7: And his brothers by their clans, when the genealogy of their generations was registered: the chief, Ye’i’ĕl, and Zeḵaryahu,
5.8: and Bela son of Azaz, son of Shema, son of Yo’ĕl, who dwelt in Aro’ĕr, as far as Neḇo and Ba’al Me’on.
5.9: And he dwelt eastward as far as the entrance of the wilderness from the River Perath, because their livestock had increased in the land of Gil’aḏ.
5.10: And in the days of Sha’ul they fought against the Haḡrites, who fell by their hand. And they dwelt in their tents over all the eastern part of Gil’aḏ.
5.11: And the children of Gaḏ dwelt next to them in the land of Bashan as far as Salḵah:
5.12: Yo’ĕl was the chief, Shapham the next, then Ya’anai and Shaphat in Bashan;
5.13: and their brothers of their father’s house: Miḵa’ĕl, and Meshullam, and Sheḇa, and Yorai, and Yakan, and Ziya, and Ĕḇer, seven.
5.14: These were the children of Aḇiḥayil son of Ḥuri, son of Yarowaḥ, son of Gil’aḏ, son of Miḵa’ĕl, son of Yeshishai, son of Yaḥdo, son of Buz;
5.15: Aḥi son of Aḇdi’ĕl, son of Guni, was chief of their father’s house.
5.16: And they dwelt in Gil’aḏ, in Bashan and in its villages, and in all the open lands of Sharon within their borders.
5.17: All these were registered by genealogies in the days of Yotham meleḵ of Yahuḏah, and in the days of Yaroḇ’am meleḵ of Yisra’ĕl.
5.18: The sons of Re’uḇĕn, and the Gaḏites, and half the tribe of Menashsheh had forty-four thousand seven hundred and sixty brave men, men able to bear shield and sword, to shoot with the bow, and skilled in battle, going out to the army.
5.19: And they fought against the Haḡrites, and Yetur, and Naphish, and Noḏaḇ.
5.20: And they were helped against them, and the Haḡrites were given into their hand, and all who were with them. For they cried out to Elohim in the battle, and He answered their prayer, because they put their trust in Him.
5.21: And they took away their livestock: fifty thousand of their camels, and two hundred and fifty thousand of their sheep, and two thousand of their donkeys, also one hundred thousand of their men,
5.22: for many fell dead, because the battle was of Elohim. And they dwelt in their place until the exile.
5.23: And the children of the half-tribe of Menashsheh dwelt in the land. They increased from Bashan to Ba’al Ḥermon, that is, to Senir, or Mount Ḥermon.
5.24: And these were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Ĕpher, and Yishi, and Eli’ĕl, and Azri’ĕl, and Yirmeyahu, Hoḏawyah, and Yaḥdi’ĕl - mighty brave men, men of name, and heads of their fathers’ houses.
5.25: But they trespassed against the Elohim of their fathers, and whored after the mighty ones of the peoples of the land, whom Elohim had destroyed before them.
5.26: So the Elohim of Yisra’ĕl stirred up the spirit of Pul meleḵ of Ashshur, even the spirit of Tiḡlath-Pileser meleḵ of Ashshur. And he took the Re’uḇĕnites, and the Gaḏites, and the half-tribe of Menashsheh into exile, and brought them to Ḥalaḥ, and Ḥaḇor, and Hara, and the river of Gozan, unto this day.

6.1: The sons of Lĕwi: Gĕreshom, Qehath, and Merari.
6.2: And the sons of Qehath: Amram, Yitshar, and Ḥeḇron, and Uzzi’ĕl.
6.3: And the children of Amram: Aharon, and Mosheh, and Miryam. And the sons of Aharon: Naḏaḇ and Aḇihu, El’azar and Ithamar.
6.4: El’azar brought forth Pineḥas, Pineḥas brought forth Aḇishua;
6.5: and Aḇishua brought forth Buqqi, and Buqqi brought forth Uzzi;
6.6: and Uzzi brought forth Zeraḥyah, and Zeraḥyah brought forth Merayoth;
6.7: Merayoth brought forth Amaryah, and Amaryah brought forth Aḥituḇ;
6.8: and Aḥituḇ brought forth Tsaḏoq, and Tsaḏoq brought forth Aḥima’ats;
6.9: and Aḥima’ats brought forth Azaryahu, and Azaryahu brought forth Yoḥanan;
6.10: and Yoḥanan brought forth Azaryahu - it was he who served as kohĕn in the House that Shelomoh built in Yerushalayim;
6.11: and Azaryahu brought forth Amaryah, and Amaryah brought forth Aḥituḇ;
6.12: and Aḥituḇ brought forth Tsaḏoq, and Tsaḏoq brought forth Shallum;
6.13: and Shallum brought forth Ḥilqiyahu, and Ḥilqiyahu brought forth Azaryahu;
6.14: and Azaryahu brought forth Serayah, and Serayah brought forth Yahotsaḏaq.
6.15: And Yahotsaḏaq went away when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 sent Yahuḏah and Yerushalayim into exile by the hand of Neḇuḵaḏnetstsar.
6.16: The sons of Lĕwi: Gĕreshom, Qehath, and Merari.
6.17: And these are the names of the sons of Gĕreshom: Liḇni and Shim’i.
6.18: And the sons of Qehath: Amram, and Yitshar, and Ḥeḇron, and Uzzi’ĕl.
6.19: The sons of Merari: Maḥli and Mushi. And these are the clans of the Lĕwites according to their fathers:
6.20: Of Gĕreshom were Liḇni his son, Yaḥath his son, Zimmah his son,
6.21: Yo’aḥ his son, Iddo his son, Zeraḥ his son, Ye’atherai his son.
6.22: The sons of Qehath: Amminaḏaḇ his son, Qoraḥ his son, Assir his son,
6.23: Elqanah his son, Eḇyasaph his son, Assir his son,
6.24: Taḥath his son, Uri’ĕl his son, Uzziyah his son, and Sha’ul his son.
6.25: And the sons of Elqanah: Amasai and Aḥimoth.
6.26: Elqanah - the sons of Elqanah: Tsophai his son, and Naḥath his son,
6.27: Eliyaḇ his son, Yeroḥam his son, Elqanah his son.
6.28: And the sons of Shemu’ĕl; the first-born Washni, and Aḇiyah.
6.29: The sons of Merari: Maḥli, Liḇni his son, Shim’i his son, Uzzah his son,
6.30: Shim’a his son, Ḥaggiyah his son, and Asayah his son.
6.31: And these are the men whom Dawiḏ appointed over the service of song in the House of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, after the ark came to rest.
6.32: And they were rendering service in song before the Mishkan of the Tent of Appointment, until Shelomoh had built the House of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 in Yerushalayim, and they performed their duties according to their ruling.
6.33: And these are the ones who stood with their sons: Of the sons of the Qehathites were Hĕman the singer, son of Yo’ĕl, son of Shemu’ĕl,
6.34: son of Elqanah, son of Yeroḥam, son of Eli’ĕl, son of Towaḥ,
6.35: son of Tsuph, son of Elqanah, son of Maḥath, son of Amasai,
6.36: son of Elqanah, son of Yo’ĕl, son of Azaryahu, son of Tsephanyah,
6.37: son of Taḥath, son of Assir, son of Eḇyasaph, son of Qoraḥ,
6.38: son of Yitshar, son of Qehath, son of Lĕwi, son of Yisra’ĕl.
6.39: And his brother Asaph, who stood at his right hand, was Asaph son of Bereḵyahu, son of Shim’a,
6.40: son of Miḵa’ĕl, son of Ba’asĕyah, son of Malkiyah,
6.41: son of Ethni, son of Zeraḥ, son of Aḏayah,
6.42: son of Ĕythan, son of Zimmah, son of Shim’i,
6.43: son of Yaḥath, son of Gĕreshom, son of Lĕwi.
6.44: And their brothers, the sons of Merari, on the left hand, were Ĕythan son of Qishi, son of Aḇdi, son of Malluḵ,
6.45: son of Ḥashaḇyah, son of Amatsyah, son of Ḥilqiyahu,
6.46: son of Amtsi, son of Bani, son of Shemer,
6.47: son of Maḥli, son of Mushi, son of Merari, son of Lĕwi.
6.48: And their brothers, the Lĕwites, were appointed to every kind of service of the Mishkan of the House of Elohim.
6.49: But Aharon and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the Most Qodesh Place, and to make atonement for Yisra’ĕl, according to all that Mosheh the servant of Elohim had commanded.
6.50: And these are the sons of Aharon: El’azar his son, Pineḥas his son, Aḇishua his son,
6.51: Buqqi his son, Uzzi his son, Zeraḥyah his son,
6.52: Merayoth his son, Amaryah his son, Aḥituḇ his son,
6.53: Tsaḏoq his son, Aḥima’ats his son.
6.54: And these were their dwelling places throughout their settlements within their borders, of the sons of Aharon, of the clan of the Qehathites, for the lot was theirs.
6.55: And they gave them Ḥeḇron in the land of Yahuḏah, with its surrounding open lands.
6.56: But the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Kalĕḇ son of Yephunneh.
6.57: And to the sons of Aharon they gave the cities of refuge: Ḥeḇron, and Liḇnah with its open lands, and Yattir, and Eshtemoa with its open lands,
6.58: and Ḥilĕn with its open lands, Deḇir with its open lands,
6.59: and Ashan with its open lands, and Bĕyth Shemesh with its open lands.
6.60: And from the tribe of Binyamin: Geḇa with its open lands, and Alemeth with its open lands, and Anathoth with its open lands. All their cities among their clans were thirteen.
6.61: And to the rest of the clan of the tribe of the Qehathites by lot ten cities from half the tribe of Menashsheh.
6.62: And to the sons of Gĕreshom, throughout their clans, thirteen cities from the tribe of Yissasḵar, and from the tribe of Ashĕr, and from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the tribe of Menashsheh in Bashan.
6.63: To the sons of Merari, throughout their clans, by lot twelve cities from the tribe of Re’uḇĕn, and from the tribe of Gaḏ, and from the tribe of Zeḇulun.
6.64: So the children of Yisra’ĕl gave cities with their open lands to the Lĕwites.
6.65: And they gave by lot from the tribe of the children of Yahuḏah, and from the tribe of the children of Shim’on, and from the tribe of the children of Binyamin these cities which are mentioned by name.
6.66: And some of the clans of the sons of Qehath had cities of their borders from the tribe of Ephrayim.
6.67: And they gave them the cities of refuge: Sheḵem with its open lands, in the mountains of Ephrayim, and Gezer with its open lands,
6.68: and Yoqme’am with its open lands, and Bĕyth Ḥoron with its open lands,
6.69: and Ayalon with its open lands, and Gath Rimmon with its open lands.
6.70: And from the half-tribe of Menashsheh: Anĕr with its open lands, and Bil’am with its open lands, for the rest of the clan of the sons of Qehath.
6.71: From the clan of the half-tribe of Menashsheh the sons of Gĕreshom: Golan in Bashan with its open lands and Ashtaroth with its open lands.
6.72: And from the tribe of Yissasḵar: Qeḏesh with its open lands, Daḇerath with its open lands,
6.73: Ramoth with its open lands, and Anĕm with its open lands.
6.74: And from the tribe of Ashĕr: Mashal with its open lands, and Aḇdon with its open lands,
6.75: and Ḥuqoq with its open lands, and Reḥoḇ with its open lands.
6.76: And from the tribe of Naphtali: Qeḏesh in Galil with its open lands, and Ḥammon with its open lands, and Qiryathayim with its open lands.
6.77: From the tribe of Zeḇulun the rest of the children of Merari: Rimmon with its open lands and Taḇor with its open lands.
6.78: And from beyond the Yardĕn of Yeriḥo, on the east side of the Yardĕn, from the tribe of Re’uḇĕn: Betser in the wilderness with its open lands, and Yahtsah with its open lands,
6.79: Qeḏĕmoth with its open lands, and Mĕpha’ath with its open lands.
6.80: And from the tribe of Gaḏ: Ramoth in Gil’aḏ with its open lands, and Maḥanayim with its open lands,
6.81: and Ḥeshbon with its open lands, and Ya’zĕr with its open lands.

7.1: And the sons of Yissasḵar: Tola, and Puw’ah, Yashuḇ, and Shimron, four.
7.2: And the sons of Tola: Uzzi, and Rephayah, and Yeri’ĕl, and Yaḥmai, and Yiḇsam, and Shemu’ĕl, heads of their father’s house. Of Tola there were great men of might in their generations; their number in the days of Dawiḏ was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
7.3: And the son of Uzzi: Yizraḥyah, and the sons of Yizraḥyah: Miḵa’ĕl, and Oḇaḏyah, and Yo’ĕl, Yishshiyah. All five of them were heads.
7.4: And with them, by their generations, according to their fathers’ houses, were thirty-six thousand, bands of the army for battle, for they had many wives and sons.
7.5: And their brothers among all the clans of Yissasḵar were mighty brave men, listed by their genealogies, eighty-seven thousand in all.
7.6: Of Binyamin: Bela, and Beḵer, and Yeḏiya’ĕl, three.
7.7: And the sons of Bela: Etsbon, and Uzzi, and Uzzi’ĕl, and Yerimoth, and Iri, five - heads of their fathers’ houses, and they were listed by their genealogies, twenty-two thousand and thirty-four mighty brave men.
7.8: And the sons of Beḵer: Zemirah, and Yo’ash, and Eli’ezer, and Elyo’ĕynai, and Omri, and Yerĕmoth, and Aḇiyah, and Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Beḵer,
7.9: with their genealogy according to their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, twenty thousand two hundred mighty brave men.
7.10: And the son of Yeḏiya’ĕl: Bilhan, and the sons of Bilhan: Ye’ush, and Binyamin, and Ĕhuḏ, and Kena’anah, and Zĕthan, and Tarshish, and Aḥishaḥar.
7.11: All these sons of Yeḏiya’ĕl were heads of their fathers’ houses, seventeen thousand two hundred mighty brave men going out to the army for battle.
7.12: And Shuppim and Ḥuppim were the sons of Ir, and Ḥushim was the son of Aḥĕr.
7.13: The sons of Naphtali: Yaḥtsi’ĕl, and Guni, and Yĕtser, and Shallum, sons of Bilhah.
7.14: The sons of Menashsheh: his Aramean concubine bore him Maḵir the father of Gil’aḏ, the father of Asri’ĕl.
7.15: And Maḵir took wives for Ḥuppim and Shuppim; and the name of one was Ma’aḵah, and the name of the second was Tselapheḥaḏ. And Tselapheḥaḏ had daughters.
7.16: But Ma’aḵah the wife of Maḵir bore a son, and she called his name Peresh. And the name of his brother was Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Raqem.
7.17: And the son of Ulam: Beḏan. These were the sons of Gil’aḏ, son of Maḵir, son of Menashsheh.
7.18: And his sister Hammoleḵeth bore Ishhod, and Aḇi’ezer, and Maḥlah.
7.19: And the sons of Shemiḏa: Aḥyan, and Sheḵem, and Liqeḥi, and Aniyam.
7.20: And the sons of Ephrayim: Shuthelaḥ, and Bereḏ his son, and Taḥath his son, and Elaḏah his son, and Taḥath his son,
7.21: and Zaḇaḏ his son, and Shuthelaḥ his son, and Ĕzer and El’aḏ. But the men of Gath who were born in that land slew them because they came down to take their livestock.
7.22: And Ephrayim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
7.23: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived and bore a son. And he called his name Beri’ah, because evil had come upon his house.
7.24: And his daughter was She’erah, who built Lower and Upper Bĕyth Ḥoron and Uzzen She’erah.
7.25: And Rephaḥ was his son, as well as Resheph, and Telaḥ his son, and Taḥan his son,
7.26: La’dan his son, Ammihuḏ his son, Elishama his son,
7.27: Nun his son, Yahoshua his son.
7.28: And their possessions and dwelling places were Bĕyth Ĕl and its towns: to the east Na’aran, and to the west Gezer and its towns, and Sheḵem and its towns, as far as Ayyah and its towns.
7.29: And by the borders of the children of Menashsheh were Bĕyth She’an and its towns, Ta’anaḵ and its towns, Meḡiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these dwelt the children of Yosĕph, son of Yisra’ĕl.
7.30: The sons of Ashĕr: Yimnah, and Yishwah, and Yishwi, and Beri’ah, and their sister Seraḥ.
7.31: And the sons of Beri’ah: Ḥeḇer and Malki’ĕl, who was the father of Birzoth.
7.32: And Ḥeḇer brought forth Yaphlĕt, and Shomĕr, and Ḥotham, and their sister Shuwa.
7.33: And the sons of Yaphlĕt: Pasaḵ, and Bimhal, and Ashwath. These were the children of Yaphlĕt.
7.34: And the sons of Shemer: Aḥi, and Rohagah, Yeḥubbah, and Aram.
7.35: And the sons of his brother Ḥĕlem: Tsophaḥ, and Yimna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
7.36: The sons of Tsophaḥ: Suwaḥ, and Ḥarnepher, and Shu’al, and Bĕri, and Yimrah,
7.37: Betser, and Hoḏ, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Yithran, and Be’ĕra.
7.38: And the sons of Yether: Yephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
7.39: And the sons of Ulla: Araḥ, and Ḥanni’ĕl, and Ritsya.
7.40: All these were the children of Ashĕr, heads of their fathers’ houses, chosen ones, mighty brave men, chief leaders. And when they registered by genealogy for the army, for battle, their number was twenty-six thousand.

8.1: And Binyamin brought forth Bela his first-born, Ashbĕl the second, Aḥraḥ the third,
8.2: Noḥah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
8.3: And the sons of Bela: Addar, and Gĕra, and Aḇihuḏ,
8.5: and Gĕra, and Shephuphan, and Ḥuram.
8.6: And these are the sons of Ĕḥuḏ. They were the heads of the fathers’ houses of the inhabitants of Geḇa, and they were exiled to Manaḥath.
8.7: And Na’aman, and Aḥiyahu, and Gĕra - he exiled them. And Ĕḥuḏ brought forth Uzza and Aḥihuḏ.
8.8: And Shaḥarayim brought forth children in the field of Mo’aḇ, after he had sent away Ḥushim and Ba’ara his wives.
8.9: And by Ḥoḏesh his wife he brought forth Yoḇaḇ, and Tsiḇya, and Mĕysha, and Malkam,
8.10: and Ye’uts, and Shoḇyah, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of their fathers’ houses.
8.11: And by Ḥushim he brought forth Aḇituḇ and Elpa’al.
8.12: And the sons of Elpa’al: Ĕḇer, and Mish’am, and Shemeḏ, who built Ono and Loḏ with its towns;
8.13: and Beri’ah and Shema, who were heads of their fathers’ houses of the inhabitants of Ayalon, who drove out the inhabitants of Gath.
8.15: and Zeḇaḏyah, and Araḏ, and Ĕḏer,
8.16: and Miḵa’ĕl, and Yispah, and Yoḥa were the sons of Beri’ah.
8.17: And Zeḇaḏyah, and Meshullam, and Ḥizqi, and Ḥeḇer,
8.18: and Yishmerai, and Yizli’ah, and Yoḇaḇ were the sons of Elpa’al.
8.19: And Yaqim, and Ziḵri, and Zaḇdi,
8.20: and Eli’ĕynai, and Tsillethai, and Eli’ĕl,
8.21: and Aḏayah, and Berayah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shim’i.
8.22: And Yishpan, and Ĕḇer, and Eli’ĕl,
8.23: and Aḇdon, and Ziḵri, and Ḥanan,
8.24: and Ḥananyah, and Ĕylam, and Antothiyah,
8.25: and Yiphdeyah, and Penu’ĕl were the sons of Shashaq.
8.26: And Shamsherai, and Sheḥaryah, and Athalyahu,
8.27: and Ya’areshyah, and Ĕliyahu, and Ziḵri were the sons of Yeroḥam.
8.28: These were heads of the fathers’ houses by their generations, heads. These dwelt in Yerushalayim.
8.29: And the father of Giḇ’on, whose wife’s name was Ma’aḵah, dwelt at Giḇ’on.
8.30: And his first-born son was Aḇdon, then Tsur, and Qish, and Ba’al, and Naḏaḇ,
8.31: and Geḏor, and Aḥyo, and Zeḵer,
8.32: and Miqloth, who brought forth Shim’ah. And they also dwelt alongside their relatives in Yerushalayim, with their brothers.
8.33: And Nĕr brought forth Qish, and Qish brought forth Sha’ul, and Sha’ul brought forth Yahonathan, and Malkishua, and Aḇinaḏaḇ, and Esh-Ba’al.
8.34: And the son of Yahonathan was Meriḇ-Ba’al, and Meriḇ-Ba’al brought forth Miḵah.
8.35: And the sons of Miḵah: Pithon, and Meleḵ, and Ta’arĕa, and Aḥaz.
8.36: And Aḥaz brought forth Yaho’addah, and Yaho’addah brought forth Alemeth, and Azmaweth, and Zimri. And Zimri brought forth Motsa.
8.37: And Motsa brought forth Bin’a, Raphah his son, El’asah his son, Atsĕl his son.
8.38: And Atsĕl had six sons whose names were these: Azriqam, Boḵeru, and Yishma’ĕl, and She’aryah, and Oḇaḏyah, and Ḥanan. All these were the sons of Atsĕl.
8.39: And the sons of Ĕsheq his brother: Ulam his first-born, Ye’ush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
8.40: And the sons of Ulam were mighty brave men, archers, and had many sons and grandsons, one hundred and fifty. These were all sons of Binyamin.

9.1: And all Yisra’ĕl registered themselves by genealogy. And see, they were written in the book of the melaḵim of Yisra’ĕl. And Yahuḏah was exiled to Baḇel for their trespass.
9.2: And the first inhabitants who were in their possessions in their cities of Yisra’ĕl, were the kohenim, the Lĕwites, and the Nethinim.
9.3: And in Yerushalayim dwelt some of the children of Yahuḏah, and some of the children of Binyamin, and some of the children of Ephrayim and Menashsheh:
9.4: Uthai son of Ammihuḏ, son of Omri, son of Imri, son of Bani, of the sons of Perets, the son of Yahuḏah.
9.5: And of the Shilonites: Asayah the first-born and his sons.
9.6: And of the sons of Zeraḥ: Ye’u’ĕl, and their brothers, six hundred and ninety.
9.7: And of the sons of Binyamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Hoḏawyah, son of Hasenu’ah;
9.8: and Yiḇneyah son of Yeroḥam; and Ĕlah son of Uzzi, son of Miḵri; and Meshullam son of Shephatyah, son of Re’uw’ĕl, son of Yiḇniyah;
9.9: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men were heads of a father’s house in their fathers’ houses.
9.10: And of the kohenim: Yeḏayah, and Yahoyariḇ, and Yaḵin;
9.11: and Azaryahu son of Ḥilqiyahu, son of Meshullam, son of Tsaḏoq, son of Merayoth, son of Aḥituḇ, the officer over the House of Elohim;
9.12: and Aḏayah son of Yeroḥam, son of Pashḥur, son of Malkiyah; and Ma’asai son of Aḏi’ĕl, son of Yaḥzĕrah, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillĕmith, son of Immĕr;
9.13: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred and sixty, able men for the work of the service of the House of Elohim.
9.14: And of the Lĕwites: Shemayah son of Ḥashshuḇ, son of Azriqam, son of Ḥashaḇyah, of the sons of Merari;
9.15: and Baqbaqqar, Ḥeresh, and Galal, and Mattanyah son of Miḵa, son of Ziḵri, son of Asaph;
9.16: and Oḇaḏyah son of Shemayah, son of Galal, son of Yeḏuthun; and Bereḵyah son of Asa, son of Elqanah, who dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
9.17: And the gatekeepers: Shallum, and Aqquḇ, and Talmon, and Aḥiman, and their brothers - Shallum the chief.
9.18: And up till then they were gatekeepers for the camps of the children of Lĕwi at the Meleḵ’s Gate on the east.
9.19: And Shallum son of Qorĕ, son of Eḇyasaph, son of Qoraḥ, and his brothers, from his father’s house, the Qorḥites, were over the work of the service, guards of the thresholds of the Tent. And their fathers had been guards of the entrance to the camp of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
9.20: And Pineḥas son of El’azar was leader over them in time past. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 was with him.
9.21: Zeḵaryah son of Meshelemyah was gatekeeper at the entrance of the Tent of Appointment.
9.22: All those chosen as gatekeepers at the thresholds were two hundred and twelve. They were registered by genealogy, in their villages. Dawiḏ and Shemu’ĕl the seer had appointed them to their office of trust.
9.23: So they and their sons were over the gates of the House of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, the House of the Tent, by watches.
9.24: The gatekeepers were on the four sides: the east, west, north, and south.
9.25: And their brothers in their villages had to come with them from time to time for seven days.
9.26: For the four chief gatekeepers were in an office of trust. They were Lĕwites, and they were over the rooms and treasuries of the House of Elohim.
9.27: And they spent the night all around the House of Elohim because they had the duty, and they were to open it morning by morning.
9.28: And some of them were over the vessels of service, for they brought them in and took them out by count.
9.29: And some of them were appointed over the vessels, even over all the vessels of the qodesh place, and over the fine flour and the wine and the oil and the incense and the spices.
9.30: And some of the sons of the kohenim blended the compound of spices.
9.31: And Mattithyah of the Lĕwites, the first-born of Shallum the Qorḥite, was entrusted with the making of the flat cakes.
9.32: And some of their brothers of the sons of the Qehathites were over the showbread, to prepare every Shabbath.
9.33: And these were the singers, heads of the fathers’ houses of the Lĕwites, in the rooms, and were exempted from other duties, for they were employed in that work day and night.
9.34: These heads of the fathers’ houses of the Lĕwites were heads throughout their generations. They dwelt at Yerushalayim.
9.35: And Ye’i’ĕl the father of Giḇ’on, whose wife’s name was Ma’aḵah, dwelt at Giḇ’on.
9.36: And his first-born son was Aḇdon, then Tsur, and Qish, and Ba’al, and Nĕr, and Naḏaḇ,
9.37: and Geḏor, and Aḥyo, and Zeḵaryah, and Miqloth.
9.38: And Miqloth brought forth Shim’am. And they too dwelt alongside their relatives in Yerushalayim, with their brothers.
9.39: And Nĕr brought forth Qish, and Qish brought forth Sha’ul, and Sha’ul brought forth Yahonathan, and Malkishua, and Aḇinaḏaḇ, and Esh-Ba’al.
9.40: And the son of Yahonathan was Meriḇ-Ba’al, and Meriḇ-Ba’al brought forth Miḵah.
9.41: And the sons of Miḵah: Pithon, and Meleḵ, and Taḥrĕa,
9.42: and Aḥaz, who brought forth Yarah; and Yarah brought forth Alemeth, and Azmaweth, and Zimri. And Zimri brought forth Motsa;
9.43: and Motsa brought forth Bin’a, and Rephayah was his son, El’asah his son, Atsĕl his son.
9.44: And Atsĕl had six sons whose names were these: Azriqam, Boḵeru, and Yishma’ĕl, and She’aryah, and Oḇaḏyah, and Ḥanan. These were the sons of Atsĕl.
